codeReview.summary: Clean, well-executed refactoring that consolidates duplicated test utilities in two scopes: (1) xorshift32/random_bytes extracted to launa-protocol/tests/common/mod.rs with a smart avoid_frame_chars parameter to reconcile the behavioral difference between property tests (avoid 0x7E/0x7D) and fuzz tests (allow all bytes). (2) make_spaapp/make_status_frame/make_ready_frame extracted to launa-integration-tests/tests/common/mod.rs from 5 test files. Cross-reference comments added between launa-core and launa-integration-tests explaining why consolidation stops here (no new workspace dependency for test-only code). Net reduction of 34 lines (160 removed, 126 added). All tests pass per handoff verification.

summary: PASS. The consolidation is thorough and well-executed. xorshift32/random_bytes are now defined once in launa-protocol/tests/common/mod.rs (with a clean avoid_frame_chars parameter to handle the behavioral difference). Three helper functions (make_spaapp, make_status_frame, make_ready_frame) are consolidated into launa-integration-tests/tests/common/mod.rs, used by all 5 integration test files. Cross-reference comments properly document the remaining duplication between launa-core and launa-integration-tests, with clear rationale for not consolidating further. No behavioral changes, no test count changes, all verification gates pass. Code quality is good: doc comments on all public functions, proper module-level documentation, clean imports.
